snippet.title: COWS IN SPACE [Donut Games - Collectors ID #12]
snippet.description:
After a failed galactic operation, the cows of earth ended up FLOATING AROUND IN SPACE -- encapsulated in air bubbles.

Brave space pilot, it's time to charge your jelly beam and get ready for an intergalactic mission to TELEPORT THE COWS back to earth!

- - - - - - -

GENRES: Puzzle, space game, galaxy shooter, strategy, physics
